function touch(state: List<Integer>): Integer {
state[0] = state[0] + 1
return 0
}
function weighted(state: List<Integer>, weight: Integer, digit: Integer): Integer {
state[0] = state[0] + weight
state[1] = state[1] * 10 + digit
return weight
}
